caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a dark brown leather saddle oriented vertically, occupying the central left part of the image. Attached to the right side of the saddle is an intricately illustrated, light blue-gray metallic ornament featuring finely engraved patterns, the prominent among which are two stylized birds facing opposite directions and three shields or medallions with radial designs. The objects are set against a plain, beige background that shows scattered, irregular brown stains and splatters, mostly concentrated on the right side. There is a small, neat signature reading "HARRY (MAN) WADJIE" in the lower right corner.
title: Stirrup
